instruction:
Start from a blank Revit project. Using the Revit GUI, create a single-storey event pavilion with an overall rectangular footprint of 14.0 m by 10.0 m near the project origin. The exterior walls should rise about 3.0 m, with one ground slab and a roof covering the footprint. Save the deliverables on the Desktop using the exact filenames required below.

The IFC export must use the IFC4 schema, have unique GlobalId values for all IfcRoot objects, and contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, one IfcBuildingStorey, three IfcSpace entities, four IfcWall entities, one IfcSlab, one IfcRoof, one IfcDoor entity, and three IfcWindow entities. Do not include IfcStair, IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcCurtainWall, or IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. Name the spaces so the normalized IfcSpace names include Event Room, Storage, and Toilet. Export a one-page Revit plan sheet PDF named result.pdf; its sheet text must include A101 PAVILION PLAN, Event Room, Storage, and Toilet. The required BIM categories must be exported as real IFC building elements/spaces, not visual-only placeholders or proxy geometry. Coordinate placement, relationship entities, GUID values, Revit type names, materials, property sets, and harmless extra metadata may vary as long as the stated model geometry, element categories, space names, schedules, sheets, and file outputs are satisfied.
